tool.title: Machine-fill empty translations with an open engine
tool.description: Fill the EMPTY msgstr entries of a layer's gettext catalogues with an open, self-hosted machine translator — OPUS-MT (Helsinki-NLP Marian models, CC-BY 4.0, run locally) or a self-hosted LibreTranslate (AGPL, Argos models) — so no freemium API quota is involved. A non-empty msgstr is never overwritten, every machine string is written `#, fuzzy`, and a string whose placeholders or markup do not round-trip is left empty and reported. The catalogue's translation node records `generatedBy: "machine"`, the engine and model, and the time; `official` is never set. A catalogue that says DO NOT MACHINE-FILL, or whose node is official, is not filled.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The layer root whose declared `translation-sources` directory is filled. Default: the current directory.

inputs.name: engine
inputs.description: `opus-mt` runs the bundled local runner (`opus-mt-runner.py`, which needs the extended Python tier); `libretranslate` calls the URL below. Absent, the command exits 2 with its usage.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: A self-hosted LibreTranslate's base URL (default `http://localhost:5000`). The hosted libretranslate.com / .de services are refused.

inputs.name: locales
inputs.description: Comma-separated locales to fill, e.g. `es,fr`. Default: every locale directory except the source locale.

inputs.name: init
inputs.description: Start a `.po` from each template that has none (locale named, `X-Folio-Official: no`, every msgstr empty) and fill it. Never the default: starting a catalogue is a decision.

inputs.name: noCreateNode
inputs.description: Skip a catalogue that has no translation node beside it, instead of writing a minimal `translation-node/v1` for it.

inputs.name: noMask
inputs.description: Send placeholders to the engine as they are, instead of as numbered stand-ins. The round-trip check runs either way.

outputs.name: catalogues
outputs.description: The `<locale>/<name>.po` catalogues written, each new string `#, fuzzy`, and their `<name>.json` translation nodes. Exit 0 something was filled · 3 nothing was · 2 could not determine · 1 the engine failed.

selection.when: A catalogue has empty entries and a first draft is wanted before a person reviews it on the translation review page. The machine draft is fuzzy and unofficial until a person adjudicates it.
selection.limits: Singular entries only: plural entries are left for a person. Catalogues that say DO NOT MACHINE-FILL, and catalogues whose node is official, are refused. Machine output into a language nobody on the project reads cannot be checked here; it is a draft for review, never a sign-off. The LibreTranslate host is whatever `--url` names (normally one on this machine), so it has no fixed remedy; without one, use `--engine opus-mt`.
selection.cost: OPUS-MT: a model download per language pair on first use (hundreds of MB) and CPU time, no per-string fee. LibreTranslate: whatever running your own instance costs.

remedies.none: OPUS-MT downloads each model once; with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and a model already in the cache, or `--runner` pointing at a runner with `--model-dir`, it runs with no network.

$comment.comment: The owner, 2026-11-14: an unrestricted, open machine-translation step for the gettext catalogues, so no freemium API quota is involved. It replaces the DeepL / Google Translate `po-translate` route `translation-manager` §3 used to recommend. The rules (never overwrite, fuzzy, placeholder round-trip, node provenance) are in cat-harness-tools `scripts/lib/machine-translation.ts`.

`translation-refresh` §4 is where a first draft of the new and fuzzy strings is made, and the step that names this Tool. A machine string stays fuzzy, so §4's own rule (clear `#, fuzzy` only on an entry actually re-translated) still holds: this Tool never clears one.
